info.name: Fuel Route API
info.description:
Smoke tests for the USA fuel-optimal route API. Import, set `base` (default http://127.0.0.1:8000), then Run the collection: every request carries assertions, so the runner shows pass/fail per call.

First-time trips make one routing-provider call each (1-4 s); repeats are cache hits (milliseconds).

exec: pm.test("ok with stations indexed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("ok"); pm.expect(b.stations_indexed).to.be.above(6000); pm.expect(b.checks.database).to.eql("ok"); });
pm.test("total gallons = distance / 10 mpg", () => pm.expect(Math.abs(b.fuel.total_gallons - b.route.total_distance_miles / 10)).to.be.below(0.5));

pm.test("stops ordered, every gap <= 500 mi", () => { const m = b.fuel_stops.map(s => s.route_mile_marker); pm.expect(m.length).to.be.above(0); let prev = 0; for (const x of m) { pm.expect(x - prev).to.be.at.most(500.05); prev = x; } pm.expect(b.route.total_distance_miles - prev).to.be.at.most(500.05); });

pm.test("stop costs sum to the total", () => { const sum = b.fuel_stops.reduce((a, s) => a + parseFloat(s.cost_usd), 0); pm.expect(Math.abs(sum - parseFloat(b.fuel.total_cost_usd))).to.be.below(0.011); });
